description.value:
♏ Scorpio rises Exalted today. This is the one day in two hundred and sixty. For the whole day your Techniques heighten as though you were 8 levels higher, and you have your Zenith Boon.

As the Ascendant Boon, but the death effect triggers at 5 needles, and your allies' hits also apply needles.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. A Zenith is scheduled by the GM, never rolled.

rules.text: This attack applies a Scarlet Needle whether it hits or misses. Antares triggers at 5 needles, and your allies' hits also apply needles.
rules.title: Antares (Zenith)
